summary.t: A white belly, a dark back, and a sky full of stars.

text.t:
The back is deep blue, scattered with points of light like a night sky, over a pale belly. It stands on yellow feet.

Most of the light comes through the dark back — this is the piece that looks most like a sky.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
